description:
The same digested price context for UP TO 50 tickers in ONE call — a watchlist / cohort snapshot
    ("which of these names are most extended, or deepest in drawdown"). Returns `results` (in input order)
    + `unresolved` (unknown / no-price-history tickers). `to`/`from_` as in `stock_prices`.

chart_range.description: Leave unset. For apps/devices that draw charts themselves: adds `chart` (≤ 65 points) to the first 5 results.
chart_range.title: Chart Range

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

from_.description: Lower bound of price history `YYYY-MM-DD` (below ~1y nulls the long windows).
from_.title: From

tickers.description: UP TO 50 items, EACH a Ava Advisor ticker OR a plain company/asset NAME — the SERVER resolves names (pass `context` to disambiguate); a watchlist/cohort. Returns `results` in input order + `unresolved`.
tickers.title: Tickers

name: stock_prices_batch
title: Batch Stock Prices
